create_GEM_Net_for_continual_learning: create a GEM Net module with episodic memory for continual learning on CIFAR or permuted MNIST
run_project2cone2_gradient_projection: run the GEM dual QP solver to project a gradient onto the cone of past task gradients
store_grad_for_past_tasks: store parameter gradients of past tasks into a gradient buffer for later constraint checking
overwrite_grad_with_corrected_vector: overwrite model parameter gradients with a corrected gradient vector when constraint violations occur
compute_offsets_for_task_outputs: compute output offsets for a given task to select the correct class range in multi-task learning
